pages.text: Didn't expect to see this so early eh?
Enchanting is a core part of Abyssal Ascent and its progression.$(br)$(br)You'll go through multiple armorsets throughout Abyssal Ascent, all of these will need to be enchanted in order to survive.
Enchanting has many upsides from vanilla here, along with many other enchants that you can use.

The most important parts of enchanting in Abyssal Ascent, is to know that;$(br)$(br) 1. Anvils do not have any NBT cap.$(br)$(br) 2. There's a disenchanting table, which allows you to disenchant any item and get the book of the enchant in return.
How you want to gain the XP required to do all of this is up to you, and please, do not try to skip enchanting.
